text.p: Wicketkeeper Wade Seccombe scored his maiden first-class century on Wednesday to save Queensland from a disastrous start in a Sheffield Shield match against Victoria.

Seccombe's 103 came after Queensland had slumped to 84 for seven shortly before tea. He was dismissed by medium-pace bowler Ian Harvey in the final over before stumps as Queensland recovered to 218 for eight at the close on the first day of play at the Melbourne Cricket Ground.
Tailender Paul Jackson was unbeaten on 31 at the close after a 134-run partnership with Seccombe.
Harvey finished with four wickets after tearing through the Queensland middle-order.

Victoria captain and all-rounder Tony Dodemaide earlier became the first Victoria player to take 300 wickets and score 3,000 runs in first-class cricket when he dismissed Queensland opener Matthew Mott and number three Jimmy Maher.
